name: Ed Elson
summary: Ed Elson appears in Part 5 of The Buildout. Part 5: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business. Argued in Part 5 (Voices that cross sides).

parts.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business

mentions.excerpt: Ed Elson’s view of unsustainable Big Tech growth requires frontier labs to remain structurally loss-making.

sides.claim: Because OpenAI and Anthropic pay their bills with venture funding of which Big Tech supplies roughly 40%, revenue Big Tech books from them is partly recycled from itself and not real growth.
If Big Tech depends heavily on OpenAI and Anthropic for revenue growth, that growth is unsustainable because both customers are massively unprofitable and may not survive.
